rounds.prompt: LeBron James is about to start his 24th NBA season, his first with the 76ers. How many different teammates did he have in his first 23 seasons?
rounds.source: Basketball-Reference, LeBron James teammates and opponents finder: 250 distinct teammates across his Cavaliers, Heat and Lakers seasons through 2025-26

rounds.prompt: The oldest known living tree is a bristlecone pine in California's White Mountains, dated by counting its growth rings. How many years old is it?
rounds.source: Guinness World Records, oldest living individual tree: Methuselah, a Great Basin bristlecone pine (4,856 years as of 2024); Rocky Mountain Tree-Ring Research OLDLIST (Methuselah, crossdated, about 4,850 years)

rounds.prompt: Mongolia has more horses than people. How many horses did the country count in its 2025 livestock census?
rounds.source: National Statistics Office of Mongolia, 2025 livestock census (preliminary results, January 2026): 58.1 million head of livestock, 5.1 million of them horses
